payload.title: Redesign the review rating grid against the Papyrus design system
payload.description:
As an editor reviewing references, I want the rating grid to speak the shared Papyrus design language, so that the Cyclotron/You comparison reads and re-skins the same way on every site that reuses it.

Scope:
- Take every tone, corner and opacity from named feed tokens; no literal palette values in the component.
- Verdict tones (Match/Miss) move into the feed layer in light and dark. Tailwind's dark: variant is .dark-scoped and never fires in this app, so the old dark: colours were dead code and a Match cell rendered dark-green ink on a dark card.
- Focus ring 3px.
- A switched-off grid never votes, whatever the caller passes.
- Keep the flat, borderless, tone-separated feed language, the container-query behaviour and the green/red verdict contract the executable specs assert.

Definition of Done: review-rating-grid.tsx holds no literal colour or corner; dark verdicts resolve through [data-color-mode=dark]; the reference-feed verdict, grid, design, refusal, lifecycle and layout scenarios pass; the grid is documented in the Papyrus design system.
